title: Marketplace Orders Shipping Charge and Payment Capture Schedule
content:
This schedule lists, for each Marketplace Orders delivery option, the shipping charge per order for buyers without and with an active Loop+ membership, the item subtotals at which shipping is waived, when the buyer's payment is captured, and who collects sales tax. All amounts are in USD.

| Delivery option | Non-member shipping charge | Non-member free-shipping threshold (item subtotal) | Member shipping charge | Member Same-Day free subtotal | Payment captured | Sales tax collected by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | 5.99 | 35.00 | 5.99 | not applicable | at shipment | Northloop |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | 12.99 | not offered | 12.99 | not applicable | at shipment | Northloop |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | 5.99 | 35.00 | 0.00 | not applicable | at shipment | Northloop |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | 9.99 | not offered | 0.00 | not applicable | at shipment | Northloop |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | 12.99 | not offered | 2.99 | 25.00 | at shipment | Northloop |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | 89.00 | not offered | 89.00 | not applicable | at order placement | Northloop |

"Not offered" means the option has no free-shipping threshold: a non-member pays the non-member charge whatever the item subtotal. The member Same-Day free subtotal has meaning only on Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day.

## Notes on the schedule

1. **Non-member free shipping.** On the two options with a threshold, a non-member pays no shipping when the item subtotal is at or above USD 35.00.
2. **Member Same-Day waiver.** On Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day, a member's USD 2.99 charge is waived when the item subtotal is at or above USD 25.00.
3. **Capture point.** Every parcel option captures payment at shipment; Large Item Freight Delivery captures at order placement.
4. **Sales tax.** On every option Northloop collects and remits sales tax as marketplace facilitator.

### Hypothetical threshold cases

| Option | Buyer | Item subtotal (example) | Shipping charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | non-member | 34.99 | 5.99 |
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | non-member | 35.00 | 0.00 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | member | 24.99 | 2.99 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | member | 25.00 | 0.00 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | non-member | 200.00 | 9.99 |

The subtotals are example inputs chosen to sit on either side of each threshold.
